puck_camera — DRIVE puck op

• 数据种类:table → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.puck_camera(table: 'dict', *, px_per_m: 'float' = 200.0, margin: 'float' = 0.06) -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import puck; puck.puck_camera(table: 'dict', *, px_per_m: 'float' = 200.0, margin: 'float' = 0.06) -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsdrive.get("puck_camera"))

用法

从正上方观察的合成相机：以等倍率将球台映射到像素的单应性(仿射)。col = (x + x_half + margin)·s，row = (y_half + margin − y)·s。返回值 {"H" world→(col,row), "Hinv", "shape", "px_per_m", "margin", "table"}。
